title: Your API keys are public because of how frontend environment variables work
description:
Your API keys are public because of how frontend environment variables work. Moving a key into .env feels like hiding it, but with that prefix the build tool copies it straight back into the browser.

Built your app with Lovable, Bolt, v0 or Replit and it keeps breaking? Get it audited: https://rescue.codeaz.org
